exposure: Nulliparous women with primary cesarean for failure to progress or cephalopelvic disproportion, stratified by BMI category
BMI categories: normal weight, overweight, obese classes I, II, and III
outcome: Dilation at last recorded cervical examination
cohort: Nulliparous and multiparous women from the Consortium of Safe Labor study (2002-2008).
finding: The rate of primary cesarean delivery for failure to progress or cephalopelvic disproportion increased with increasing BMI, while the rate for malpresentation decreased.
